_about: SYNTHETIC examples of high-quality past lab requests, in the request-form format. Optional: nothing depends on them. They show the thinking behind a good request, open as a copy in the form page, and give the quality check a reference. Real examples go in data/private/lab_requests/ (gitignored) with the same format and an index.json.

examples.title: Warpage through lead-free reflow, SYN-10001 Rev C
why_good: States the objective and the decision it supports, with the acceptance limit.
Gives the full thermal profile and capture temperatures, so the lab can check them against the chamber limits.
Names the measurement area and datum, so results are comparable.
Gives storage history and preconditioning, the most common reason warpage results are rejected.
Cites procedures with revisions, and asks for contour maps only where needed.

examples.title: Thermal cycling 500 cycles with readouts, SYN-10003 Rev B
why_good: Gives every profile parameter the procedure requires (min, max, dwell, ramp, cycles).
Defines readouts and what is measured at each one.
Checks the profile against the chamber range before submitting.
Says what to do if something goes wrong mid-test (a stop condition).

examples.title: Warpage before and after cycling, control group design
why_good: Explains the test design choice (control group) and the rule behind it.
Keeps 5 samples per condition, the procedure minimum.
Repeats preconditioning before each thermal step.
Lets the lab see the whole sequence per group in one place.

examples.title: BGA board attach and dynamic warpage, synthetic interposer
why_good: Uses the same part identity on every table, so the lab can follow one part through the build.
States the stencil number and placement method.
Gives the capture temperatures and the decision the data supports.

examples.title: Warpage sample fixture plates, two parts
why_good: One job with every part listed, sharing the requester, cost center and job details.
Each part has its drawing and matching STEP file.
Scope gives the purpose, critical features with tolerances, finish and inspection.
Says what can be relaxed if a tolerance cannot be held.

examples.title: Pneumatic fittings for fixture build
why_good: Quote number given and the quote attached.
Supplier code given, so no vendor set-up delay.
Every line has the supplier part number, unit of measure and quoted price.
Account and project are complete, and the date is a real date.
